title: 空と土地
theme: the surface landscape around a remote mountain mine entrance on a calm overcast-bright day, realistic photographic materials

cells.name: 雲のある空
cells.prompt: looking up at a bright blue sky with soft scattered white cumulus clouds, no sun, no horizon, no trees

cells.name: 遠くの山並み
cells.prompt: panoramic band of pale blue-grey hazy distant forested mountain ridges filling the lower two thirds, against a pure black background above, no sky, no clouds

cells.name: 芝地
cells.prompt: short green field grass with a few clover leaves and small bare patches, seen from directly above, about 2 m across

cells.name: 未舗装路
cells.prompt: packed brown dirt road with faint tyre ruts, small stones and dried puddle marks, seen from directly above, about 2 m across

cells.name: アスファルト
cells.prompt: weathered dark grey asphalt road surface with fine aggregate and a few sealed cracks, seen from directly above, about 2 m across

cells.name: 砂利敷き
cells.prompt: light grey crushed gravel yard surface, angular stones 2-3 cm, seen from directly above, about 1.5 m across

cells.name: 花崗岩
cells.prompt: weathered speckled grey and pink granite outcrop with lichen spots and cracks, about 2 m across

cells.name: 林床
cells.prompt: forest floor of brown pine needles, small cones, twigs and dark soil, seen from directly above, about 2 m across

cells.name: 切土の斜面
cells.prompt: eroded hillside cut of orange-brown clay soil with embedded stones, fine roots and sparse grass tufts, about 2 m across
